sources.version: CSS Fonts Module Level 4 Working Draft
sources.notes: Defines @font-face descriptors including unicode-range and font metric overrides. Working Draft; syntax may evolve.
Defines sxHeight, sCapHeight and sTypo* metrics used for fallback metric matching.

assumptions: Both files expose comparable typographic metrics. x-height and cap-height matching use OS/2 metrics when available.
licensing_data_restrictions: No user content is transmitted by normal tool execution. Third-party libraries retain their upstream licenses; font/PDF licensing remains the user’s responsibility.
uncertainty: Metric matching reduces geometric differences but cannot make glyph shapes, hinting, kerning, or script shaping identical. Variable-font instance metrics can differ from default metrics.
